highlights: Glass panels: backdrop-filter: blur(20px) over rgba(255,255,255,0.03) backgrounds with 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06) borders
Glass blur effects on secondary buttons: backdrop-filter: blur(4px)
Glass blur on header: backdrop-filter: blur(20px) over semi-transparent dark background
Radial gradient glow effects positioned at top-left corners with 400px diameter circles
Edge highlight effects using radial-gradient masks with elliptical shapes
Noise/grain texture overlay at opacity 0.9 with mix-blend-mode: overlay on surfaces
Subtle grain textures at opacity 0.6 on panels and cards
Shine effects using radial-gradient masks with 200px beam length
Gradient border effects using CSS mask-composite with linear gradients
Shadow stack effects with multiple layered box-shadows on elevated surfaces
